method: Fresh frontier plus current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence. Canonical and index mechanics synchronized for the eight records.
evidence_boundary: Source-reported costs, availability, stages, modifiers, damage, and behavior are retained as source-bound. Exact frames, hidden interactions, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not inferred.
validation_target: 474 canonical records and 474 index records; no additions/removals.
